papers.title: Batched Gaussian Process Bandit Optimization via Determinantal Point Processes
papers.abstract: Gaussian Process bandit optimization has emerged as a powerful tool for optimizing noisy black box functions. One example in machine learning is hyper-parameter optimization where each evaluation of the target function requires training a model which may involve days or even weeks of computation. Most methods for this so-called "Bayesian optimization" only allow sequential exploration of the parameter space. However, it is often desirable to propose batches or sets of parameter values to explore simultaneously, especially when there are large parallel processing facilities at our disposal. Batch methods require modeling the interaction between the different evaluations in the batch, which can be expensive in complex scenarios. In this paper, we propose a new approach for parallelizing Bayesian optimization by modeling the diversity of a batch via Determinantal point processes (DPPs) whose kernels are learned automatically. This allows us to generalize a previous result as well as prove better regret bounds based on DPP sampling. Our experiments on a variety of synthetic and real-world robotics and hyper-parameter optimization tasks indicate that our DPP-based methods, especially those based on DPP sampling, outperform state-of-the-art methods.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的批量贝叶斯优化方法可用于高效探索设计空间，但未涉及生物力学有限元建模或替代模型构建。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element surrogate modeling, does not involve biomedical implant design, and lacks physical constraints or uncertainty quantification in the context of mechanical simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速黑箱函数优化，解决大规模并行条件下的参数探索效率问题。
summary_zh.method: 基于行列式点过程的批量高斯过程优化，自动学习核函数以建模批次多样性。
summary_zh.result: 在合成任务和机器人/超参数优化中优于现有批量方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成数据和真实世界优化任务进行性能评估。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate black-box function optimization under large-scale parallel evaluation settings.
summary_en.method: A batch Gaussian process optimization framework using determinantal point processes with automatically learned kernels to model batch diversity.
summary_en.result: The proposed DPP-based methods outperform state-of-the-art batch Bayesian optimization on synthetic and real-world robotics/hyperparameter optimization tasks.
summary_en.validation: Performance evaluated on synthetic benchmarks and real-world optimization tasks (robotics, hyperparameter tuning).

papers.title: Electropolishing and electropolishing-related allowances for powder bed selectively laser-melted Ti-6Al-4V alloy components
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, École de technologie supérieure, 1100, Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, H3C 1K3, Canada

corresponding_authors.name: Vladimir Braïlovski
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, École de technologie supérieure, 1100, Notre-Dame Street West, Montreal, Quebec, H3C 1K3, Canada

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于增材制造钛合金的后处理电抛光工艺，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structure design, stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or osseointegration; it focuses solely on surface finishing via electropolishing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究电抛光对选区激光熔化Ti-6Al-4V合金表面质量的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过实验测量电抛光前后表面粗糙度和材料去除量
summary_zh.result: 电抛光可显著降低表面粗糙度，但需考虑尺寸变化补偿
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量表面粗糙度和材料去除量

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of electropolishing on the surface quality of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V components.
summary_en.method: Experimental measurement of surface roughness and material removal before and after electropolishing.
summary_en.result: Electropolishing significantly reduces surface roughness but requires allowance for dimensional changes.
summary_en.validation: Experimental surface roughness and material removal measurements.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于行列式点过程的批量贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on general black-box optimization with no application to FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or biomechanics constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 并行贝叶斯优化中如何高效选择批量评估点以平衡探索与多样性。
summary_zh.method: 利用行列式点过程建模批量点的多样性，并自动学习核函数。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实任务上优于现有批量优化方法，并证明了更优的遗憾界。
summary_zh.validation: 在机器人学和超参数优化任务上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient parallel evaluation in Bayesian optimization by selecting diverse batches of points.
summary_en.method: Models batch diversity via determinantal point processes with automatically learned kernels.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art batch methods on synthetic and real-world tasks, with improved regret bounds.
summary_en.validation: Validated on robotics and hyperparameter optimization benchmarks.
